_context.projects.trigger: Accessible name of the button that opens the project list; {repo} is a GitHub owner/name.
_context.projects.probe.no_github_remote: A git remote named origin that points at GitHub.
_context.controls.state: Short label of the factory state. DRAINING is the normal stop: the factory finishes what runs, then stops.
_context.controls.hardStop: Stops the factory at once and cancels everything that runs.
_context.orders.ask: The foreman's question once a project is chosen; {repo} is a GitHub owner/name.
_context.providers.label: Short caption next to the on/off switch of a connection: whether the factory may use it.
_context.floor.dataAgeSeconds: Shown next to the factory status dot when the factory stopped reporting; {seconds} is the whole seconds (1-59) since its last report.
_context.floor.dataAgeMinutes: Shown next to the factory status dot when the factory stopped reporting; {minutes} is the whole minutes (1-59) since its last report.
_context.floor.dataAgeHours: Shown next to the factory status dot when the factory stopped reporting; {hours} is the whole hours since its last report.
_context.floor.asOf: Shown under a live count when the factory stopped reporting: the count is the one of its last report; {time} is that report's local time, HH:MM.
_context.controls.holdLong: Short text of the factory state pill while sending is held; {kind} is the hold reason as the factory reports it (for example sign-in renewal), {seconds} the seconds left.
_context.controls.holdSentence: Full sentence behind the state pill while sending is held; {time} is the local time the hold ends, HH:MM.
_context.floor.moreMetrics: Accessible name of the tile that gathers the figures hidden on a narrow screen.
_context.floor.center: Button that moves the factory map so the bots are in the middle of the visible floor; the zoom stays.
_context.floor.centerHint: Tooltip of the center button. Key 0 does the same when the map has focus.
_context.controls.idleSentence: Full sentence behind the state pill when the factory runs but has nothing it may work on; {reason} is controls.wait.
_context.controls.wait: Why the factory has nothing to work on, as the factory reports it; other {text} is the factory's own English text, shown as is.
_context.floor.waitingOutside: After the Waiting count: how many waiting jobs are not in the work order, so they will not start.
_context.controls.startBlocked: Tooltip and accessible name of the Start button while it is unavailable; {need} is what is missing before the factory has work to start on.
_context.controls.idleShort: Short text of the state pill on a narrow bar when the factory runs with nothing to work on: names the missing thing in one or two words.
